scope: Independent offline audit of the completed native Mobile v7 fixture, actual terminal byte/mode evidence and five selected browser captures.

actual_native.intentional_outage_exit: Target backend returned130 after original-owner SIGTERM.

backend_stops.qualification: Cleanup used explicit --force; no non-forcing stop claim.

terminal.scope: Actual private PTY bytes, modes and geometry; no native Terminal application pixel claim.

observed_states: Stable owner declaration with current-read acknowledgement
Mobile/intermittent owner declaration with current-read acknowledgement
Offline connection with last reported stale Mobile and unknown resource availability
Reachable rejoin with current Mobile and fresh report explicitly requiring destination admission
Revoked peer with unknown/unsupported declaration and unknown unavailable-for-placement resources
browser.remote_read_only: Selected peer captures have no owner setter; source-local setter shown separately.
browser.own_tabs_reset_and_closed: Coordinator positive closure, retained in implementation review; this audit performed no browser control.

historical_failure.qualification: Prior projection-oracle failure and ENOTTY/unverified restoration remain preserved; v7 supplies separate corrected fixture evidence.

limits: Finite same-host transport outage and restart at the same saved endpoint only.
Owner availability is advisory, separate from connection/resource freshness, not a scheduler or resource entitlement.
Fresh resource reports still require destination admission.
No physical suspend, roaming, Linux, provider-workload, current-main composition, public-install, hermetic or escaped-descendant claim.
This audit did not rerun a helper, binary, test, queue job or browser interaction.
